JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Misc. Robots
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Misc. Robots: hauling and cleaning robots bought from traders.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: On RimWorld 1.7 the base mod has only haulers and cleaners; builder robots come from Misc. Robots++.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Misc. Robots++
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Misc. Robots++: kitchen, crafter, builder, ER and omni robots in five tiers (skill 4 to 20).
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: Vanilla rolls mechanoid work with a fixed skill of 10; robots do not use their own skill there.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.advice: QualityBuilder × Misc. Robots makes robots roll with their own skill.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: QualityBuilder × Misc. Robots
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: QualityBuilder × Misc. Robots: robots may build QualityBuilder frames when their roll can reach the minimum quality.
